learnings: Tool errors (API failures, model output parsing errors) can cause inconclusive results even when packages are clearly safe - need better error handling and retry logic
Model output parsing should be more robust to handle malformed responses, especially when models get confused by prompt instructions
The advisory:true flag correctly prevented a failed audit from counting as a vote, which is good design
When multiple models review the same files and one completes successfully while others fail due to tool errors, the successful audit should be weighted appropriately
